text:
Elena V: quick sync — axis unit shorthand + legend stacking + outlier treatment. Panel looks noisy when p50/p95/p99 overlays show. Thoughts on unit copy?
Sam B: prefer `/s` on-axis, but allow click-to-expand to 'Requests per second (req/s)' in a tooltip. axis needs to be dense for small panels.
Priya L: agree. Also suggest an explicit small dropdown in panel header for units (per sec / per min / absolute) so dashboards with mixed units don't confuse readers. remembers per-user.
Omar Q: legend problem: when smoothing is toggled we stack items vertically and panels get taller. Proposal: when smoothing on, display smoothed series with full weight and collapse raw under a single 'Raw (hidden)' row with a chevron to expand.
Elena V: collapse should be accessible — aria-expanded on the row, and focusable action like 'Show raw'.
A11yBot: A11Y note: announce changes with aria-live ("Legend updated: raw series collapsed"). Also ensure collapsed rows are reachable by keyboard and screen readers read state.
Priya L: outlier UX: product wants a "clean view" mode. Two options: hard clip at percentile (changes scale) vs. visual ghosting (reduce alpha + add dashed outline). I prefer ghosting to avoid altering scale.
Sam B: ghosting is neat — keeps hover and exports intact. maybe call it "Ghost outliers"? Microcopy could be confusing.
Omar Q: microcopy suggestion: label: "De-emphasize outliers" helper: "Ghost isolated spikes visually; underlying values unchanged." short and clear.
Elena V: add a helper toggle right next to smoothing: "De-emphasize outliers (ghost)" and a small info icon linking to docs.
A11yBot: accessibility: don't rely on opacity alone. When ghosting is on, add an offscreen description line in the chart caption: "Outlier de-emphasis enabled." Announce on toggle via aria-live. Ensure ghosted points remain in tab order and have focus styles.
Priya L: keyboard shortcuts: `U` to open units menu, `L` to focus legend, arrows to move, Enter to toggle expand/collapse. Add to shortcuts modal.
Sam B: implementation note: keep raw series DOM nodes but add `.point--ghost { opacity: 0.25; stroke-dasharray: 2 2; pointer-events: auto }` so hover and screen-reader description still work.
Omar Q: for power users, add an advanced "Clip outliers (affects scale)" switch with a clear warning; off by default.
Elena V: action items: update figma with units dropdown and collapsed legend state, implement prop `deEmphasizeOutliers` behind `console.featureFlags.ghostOutliers`, include aria strings and unit tooltip copy. I'll open a PR and tag beta teams.
A11yBot: test checklist: aria-live announcements, offscreen descriptions for ghosted points, legend keyboard nav tests, ensure tooltip unit copy uses sentence case.
Elena V: thanks — will post mocks and PR link here when ready.
